components.name: Archive primary button
components.description: The black scene-creation action on the light archive.
components.css: .ds-primary{padding:12px 22px;background:#191919;color:#f5f5f5;border:0;border-radius:3px;font:13px var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace);cursor:pointer}.ds-primary:hover{background:#3a3a3a}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Camera secondary button
components.description: Neutral camera operations; pressed state uses pale fill.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:36px;background:#2b2b2b;border:1px solid #494949;border-radius:4px;padding:7px 10px;color:#ededed;font:13px/1.6 var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace);white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#3b3b3b;border-color:#717171}.ds-secondary[aria-pressed=true]{background:#e5e5e5;border-color:#e5e5e5;color:#141414}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #eee;outline-offset:2px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Camera field
components.description: Native camera field with a visible label and pale keyboard focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">镜头名称<input aria-label="镜头名称" value="空桌 · 开场"></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:14px 0;color:#c7c7c7;font:12px/1.6 var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace)}.ds-field input{width:65%;min-width:0;background:#202020;border:1px solid #444;border-radius:4px;color:#ededed;font:inherit;padding:7px 8px;caret-color:currentColor}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #eee;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: The two labeled groups, including a persistent pressed state.
components.html: <nav class="ds-workspaces" aria-label="工作区"><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">空间搭建</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">导演工作台</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-workspaces{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#101010}.ds-workspaces button{display:flex;min-height:44px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:10px 20px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;font:500 14px var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace);color:#bdbdbd;white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color 180ms,color 180ms;cursor:pointer}.ds-workspaces button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#f0f0f0;color:#111}.ds-workspaces button:hover:not(:disabled):not([aria-pressed=true]){background:#272727;color:#fff}.ds-workspaces button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f5f5f5;outline-offset:3px}.ds-workspaces button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-workspaces button{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Rehearsal status
components.description: Transport status pairs Chinese text with a shape; recording is a square.
components.css: .ds-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid #494949;border-radius:3px;padding:3px 6px;font:12px/1.6 var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace);white-space:nowrap;color:#c7c7c7}.ds-status::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:50%}.ds-status:not([data-state=idle]){background:#e5e5e5;border-color:#e5e5e5;color:#141414}.ds-status[data-state=recording]::before{background:currentColor;border-radius:0}

components.name: Selected shot card
components.description: A selectable shot row with index, title, duration and an inset selection edge.
components.css: .ds-shot{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;width:100%;text-align:left;border:1px solid #3c3c3c;background:#202020;color:#ededed;border-radius:4px;padding:12px;font:13px/1.6 var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace);cursor:pointer}.ds-shot:hover{background:#2c2c2c}.ds-shot[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:#bdbdbd;background:#303030;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 #eee}.ds-shot span,.ds-shot small{font:12px/1.5 var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace);color:#bdbdbd}.ds-shot strong{font-weight:500;font-size:13px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-shot:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #eee;outline-offset:2px}.ds-shot:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: DiaStage identity
components.description: The authored SVG, continuous white-and-black word blocks and fixed English subtitle.
components.html: 咫角DiaStageAI Dramaturgy & Spatial Previs
components.css: .ds-identity{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;color:#f5f5f5;background:#101010;font-family:var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace)}.ds-identity>svg{width:36px;height:36px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-identity>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}.ds-identity strong{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:23px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:0}.ds-cn{font-family:var(--font-diastage,"Courier New","Source Han Sans SC",monospace);font-size:28px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0}.ds-slogan{font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;color:#bfbfbf;letter-spacing:.055em;white-space:nowrap}.ds-cn,.ds-en{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:34px;padding-inline:4px;background:#fff;color:#000}

narrative.overview:
咫角 DiaStage pairs a dark working stage with a light scene archive. Courier New Latin lettering and Source Han Sans SC Chinese text give the director a calm, legible desk; the live scene remains the dominant creative surface.

The brand is 咫角 DiaStage, with the fixed subtitle AI Dramaturgy & Spatial Previs. Interface copy is Chinese. The geometric corner mark is authored SVG; no generated raster media was introduced.
keyCharacteristics: Black, white and gray interface chrome.
Two explicit workspaces with labeled tools and clear pressed states.
Rectangular controls, fine dividers and restrained motion.

rules.name: The Content Color Rule
rules.body: Keep interface chrome monochrome; preserve the colors of the scene itself.

dos: Do use Courier New for English and bundled Source Han Sans SC for Chinese, with one continuous white background per brand word.
Do preserve visible focus, text labels, pressed states and reduced-motion support.
Do use the existing model, material and scene-thumbnail colors without recoloring their content.
donts: Don't introduce a decorative accent palette, gradients or glass panels into the DiaStage chrome.
Don't add modeling overlays to the director's viewport or merge the two workspace tool groups.
Don't invent raster imagery or replace the authored geometric SVG identity.
